parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: RulesId
parameters.description: The ID of the caption rule.

parameters.name: SuffixName
parameters.description:
The caption suffix.

> Set this parameter to the value of SubtitleName that is specified for the caption template.
